visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a high-definition close-up of two glossy, brown-marinated eggs resting on a dark plate, garnished with green onion bits. A soft-boiled egg is then shown being sliced over a bowl of beef and rice, revealing a runny, vibrant yellow yolk. (2) The scene shifts to a grey textured pot on a stove where water is boiling vigorously. Hands appear, sprinkling white salt and pouring clear white vinegar into the water. A glass bowl contains ten white eggs. (3) A slotted spoon gently lowers the white eggs into the boiling water. (4) The focus moves to a glass bowl on a wooden surface where clear water, dark soy sauce, and thick syrup are poured. Hands then add chopped onions, red chilies, green onions, and garlic into the mixture. (5) The sauce is stirred with a spoon, and several peeled, soft-boiled eggs are submerged into the marinade. A white paper towel is pressed down onto the surface of the liquid to ensure the eggs are fully covered. (6) A man in a black t-shirt with a wolf graphic speaks directly to the camera in a kitchen studio setting with utensils hanging in the background. (7) Thin slices of raw beef are placed into a hot pan and stirred with chopsticks until browned. (8) The egg marinade is poured over the sizzling beef. (9) The final dish is assembled, showing the beef over rice with the marinated egg halves, garnished with a handful of fresh chopped green onions.
